Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

I joined a new support group recently for people trying dieting, and I met two people my first day who were really nice to me. One was slim and the other was overweight. The next week that I went to the dieting support group, though, I only saw the slim person, and was later told that the overweight one had decided to leave the group since they didn't want to diet anymore. Who gave up on their diet?
A. The slim person
B. Unknown
C. The overweight person
